verdict.rationale: Airbyte's own docs page on MCP servers says MCP-capable agents such as Claude, Cursor, VS Code, ChatGPT and Codex can connect to user data through Airbyte Agents, and a probe confirms the MCP server is documented first-party. This is a direct, first-party capability, but the pack only shows the headline claim, and the page sits under a /community/ path, which leaves some doubt about its official status. Missing for 10: setup/auth and transport details, a list of exposed tools/actions, clarity on official vs community status, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
